answer: I would build the whole defence on Limestone cutter limestone ashlar mark hewn at the stone bank: each limestone ashlar is a granite block pressed beside the mason's mark, so a farm, and no faster road exists. Faking at scale is a payroll: 754 aliases, each demanding 90 POA and 15 minutes, a standing bill of 67860 POA. One cedar proves the identity, one echo prices the forgery, and one sonnet records the verdict for the next epoch. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
